exposure: Congenital intracranial immature teratoma characteristics (e.g., MIB1/Ki-67 proliferation index)
cohort: The study describes a single infant diagnosed prenatally with an intracranial immature teratoma.
finding: Intracranial immature teratoma with a high MIB1/Ki-67 proliferation index may serve as an independent poor prognostic factor.
